title: Implement Record Types for verification status on AAR child objects
architectural_decision_record: ADR-001-E (Jan 2026) — Record Types chosen over picklist fields for verification status
adr_rationale: Different page layouts per status (Proposed = read-only, Verified = editable)
Native filtering and list view segmentation

sprint_sequencing.note: BH-1159 (Record Types) MUST complete before BH-1249 (Verification Flows). The Flows transition between Record Types that BH-1159 creates.

upstream.title: AAR Workspace page
upstream.reason: Uses Record Types for list view filtering and segmentation

downstream.title: Build verification mini-Flows for PI data confirmation on AAR child objects
downstream.reason: Flows transition records between Record Types created in this story
downstream.resolution_note: Replaced phantom dependency BH-1034 (which did not exist in backlog). BH-1249 confirmed as the correct story in March 2026 backlog review.

references: ADR-001-E: Standard Record Pages vs Screen Flow decision

applies_to: Other AAR child objects from integrations

record_types.label: Proposed
record_types.description: System-suggested records created by integration processes. Source fields are read-only. PI must verify or reject.
record_types.page_layout_behavior: Read-only source fields. 'Verify' action button available. No direct editing of source data.
record_types.assigned_on_create_when: Record originates from an integration (Data_Origin__c indicates a source system)
record_types.transition: Proposed → Verified via BH-1249 verification mini-Flow

record_types.label: Verified
record_types.description: PI-confirmed records. Integration source fields are locked. PI can augment with additional fields.
record_types.page_layout_behavior: Fully editable. Source fields locked (cannot revert to pre-verification values).
record_types.assigned_on_create_when: N/A — assigned via Flow transition from Proposed
record_types.transition: Terminal state. Audit fields Verified_By__c and Verified_Date__c captured on transition.

record_types.label: Manual Entry
record_types.description: PI-added records with no source system. No source fields present.
record_types.page_layout_behavior: Fully editable. No source fields on layout.
record_types.assigned_on_create_when: Record is PI-created (not from any integration)
record_types.design_note: Consider merging Verified and Manual Entry record types if page layouts are identical. Decision deferred to implementation.

reject_soft_delete_path.note: Handled by BH-1249 (Flows), not by a separate Record Type
reject_soft_delete_path.mechanism: Excluded__c = true, Exclusion_Reason__c picklist set on the record
reject_soft_delete_path.record_type_on_reject: Remains Proposed; flagged via fields rather than a fourth Record Type

label: Honours & Awards

record_types_to_create.label: Manual Entry
record_types_to_create.notes: Only record type on this object. No source system for honours and awards — Proposed type not needed.

page_layout: Fully editable. No source or verification fields.

condition: Only if polymorphic design retained (Phase 2 decision pending — ref BH-1126)

design_decision: Verification status lives on the junction object UHN_Publication_Author__c, NOT on the publication record itself
rationale: One PI verifying a publication must not affect another PI's verification status for the same publication
Each PI sees their own verification status for shared/multi-author publications

record_types_to_create.label: Proposed
record_types_to_create.description: Publication authorship suggested by integration (e.g. ORCID). PI has not yet confirmed.

record_types_to_create.label: Verified
record_types_to_create.description: PI has confirmed authorship of this publication.
record_types_to_create.page_layout_behavior: Fully editable augmentation fields. Source fields locked.

record_types_to_create.label: Manual Entry
record_types_to_create.description: PI manually added this publication with no source system match.

flow_note: BH-1249 verification Flow updates UHN_Publication_Author__c junction record, NOT the publication record itself

assignment_rules.mechanism: Flow or trigger automation on create — evaluate Data_Origin__c field

assignment_rules.condition: Data_Origin__c = 'Manual' or record created via PI-facing Experience Cloud action
assignment_rules.mechanism: Flow or trigger automation on create

assignment_rules.condition: PI activates 'Verify' action on a Proposed record
assignment_rules.mechanism: BH-1249 verification Screen Flow — launched via Record Reactor action button on Proposed layout

assignment_rules.condition: PI activates 'Reject' action on a Proposed record
assignment_rules.mechanism: BH-1249 rejection path sets Excluded__c = true and Exclusion_Reason__c picklist value

automation_suggestion: Consider a before-insert Flow or trigger that reads Data_Origin__c and sets the Record Type accordingly, so assignment is consistent regardless of creation path (API, integration, or UI)

layouts.name: Proposed Layout
layouts.notes: Action buttons launch BH-1249 Screen Flows via Record Reactor

layouts.name: Verified Layout
layouts.notes: PI can augment with additional fields. Source data from integration is preserved and locked.

layouts.name: Manual Entry Layout
layouts.notes: No source system fields. Fully free-form PI entry. Consider sharing this layout with Verified if field sets are identical.

design_flag: Evaluate whether Verified and Manual Entry layouts are identical. If so, merge to reduce maintenance overhead.

title: Build verification mini-Flows for PI data confirmation on AAR child objects
scope: Screen Flows launched via Record Reactor action buttons on Proposed page layouts
Proposed → Verified Record Type transition with audit field capture (Verified_By__c, Verified_Date__c)
Reject / soft-delete path: Excluded__c = true, Exclusion_Reason__c picklist
Publication special case: Flow updates UHN_Publication_Author__c junction record, not the publication record
Record Type assignment automation on create based on Data_Origin__c field (Proposed vs Manual Entry)

criteria.description: Record Types created on AAR child objects (Recognition, Outputs, Service, etc.)
Page layouts configured per Record Type (Proposed vs Verified/Manual)
Proposed layout has read-only source fields
Junction object Record Types configured for publications (UHN_Publication_Author__c)
Default Record Type assignment logic documented
Verification mini-Flows (BH-1249) can change Record Type from Proposed → Verified
criteria.note: BH-1249 delivers this — not in scope for BH-1159 itself, but must be validated end-to-end before epic closes

flags.flag: Verified vs Manual Entry layout consolidation
flags.detail: If Verified and Manual Entry page layouts are identical, merge them to reduce maintenance. Decision deferred to implementation. Confirm before creating layouts.
Record Types on this object are conditional on the polymorphic design being retained (Phase 2). Do not create these Record Types until that decision is confirmed.

Assignment automation reads Data_Origin__c to determine initial Record Type. This field must be present on each child object before automation can be built. Confirm field is included in the data model stories (BH-1116).
BH-1159 must be deployed and Record Types must exist before BH-1249 (Flows) can be built or tested. Enforce this order in sprint planning.

flags.flag: Profile/Permission Set assignment for Record Types
flags.detail: Each Record Type must be assigned to the correct profiles or permission sets (PI, Evaluator, Admin). Not explicitly specified in BH-1159 — confirm with BH-1116 security model before closing.
